game_start.intro: Mambu ya kisalu kianza. Mambu ya kikundi: {trump_suit} (kadi ya kikundi: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
O wewe mukendi {player_id} na German Whist.
{phase_info}
O wewe udi na {hand_size} kadi.
Tambula kadi na '[play N]', wapi N i posisioni yake na maboko nge (kwa mfano '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: KIPindi cha KUJIFUNZA: mshindi wa kila kifuli akota kadi iliyo wazi na mshindiwa akota kadi inayofuata kutoka kwenye sitaha. Majaribio yaliyoshinda katika kipindi hiki hayahesabiwi kuelekea ushindi.
player_prompt.phase_playing: Konso mayele ya mbi yina bo tasadila banda ntangu yai, tanatila beto kununga.

next_card.playing_phase: Bo kepesa ve ata karti mosi - kitini ya bansaka meyantika.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mutindu ya kusala kitambi kele mbote ve. Sadila '[play N]' sambu na kubula karte N-THE yina nge kele ti yo na maboko.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Nge fwete landa mbandu na yandi mpi kubula karte {lead_suit}.
invalid_move.invalid_play: Beto lenda sadila ve karti yina.

trick.won: Muntu yina kebula {winner_id} kebakaka nsaka ya bo mebutila yandi na maboko ti {card}.
trick.won_learning: Mchezaji {winner_id} akunda mchezo na {card} na akota kadi iliyoko juu.

phase.learning_complete: Mambu yonso ya bo vandaka kulonga na kati me mana - konso mayele yina kele mfunu sambu na kununga.

draw.winner_received: Nge me nunga mpi nge me baka {card}.
draw.loser_received: Nge me vidisa mayele ya kusala nsaka mpi nge me baka {card} na zulu ya mesa.

turn.scores_learning: Kadi zilizoshinda mpaka sasa - Mwana-salu 0: {tricks0}, Mwana-salu 1: {tricks1}

hand.no_cards: Bo ta pesa nge ve bakarti.
